name: Carnoustie Ayurveda & Wellness Resort
summary: Carnoustie is an Ayurveda and wellness resort on the Arabian Sea coast at Mararikulam, near Alappuzha. Its programmes include Panchakarma detox, rejuvenation, weight management and care for long-term conditions.
highlights: Classified Ayur Diamond by the Department of Tourism, Government of Kerala
Best Wellness Resort, FICCI Travel & Tourism Excellence Awards 2026
Best Ayurvedic Wellness Spa, Global Spa Awards 2025
Programmes: Panchakarma detox, rejuvenation, weight loss, anti-ageing, diabetes management, pain and injury, women's health
